transcript: Real healing doesn't start when the pain is gone. It starts when you stop pretending you're fine. You can ignore it, distract yourself, scroll for hours, but your body always keeps the score. That tight chest, that heavy feeling when you wake up, it's your soul asking you to stop running. Healing isn't about fixing what's broken, it's about finally listening to what's been silent for too long. When you sit with your pain instead of escaping it, you begin to understand what it came to teach you, and that's the moment. Your energy starts to return, your heart starts to trust again, and peace slowly finds its way back home. If you're tired of quick fixes and want to learn how real healing begins, you'll find my e-book in the link on my profile. It's helped thousands remember how to listen to their own body again.
